verify.note: Closed 2026-09-29 (ADR-1617). The proxy gates fq_acct and fq_ask through shouldWriteMarker, and a Server Action or prefetch that already holds the marker gets none. instrumentation-client installs the prefetch fuse, and the real fuse, replaying 25 Links every 1.5 s for a minute, lets at most 60 through: 4 per route, and no navigation blocked. The heartbeat reads a module-level gate that refuses two pings inside 60 s and backs off on failure. Fails on main at the first arm. Exits 79 only when a file is gone.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1617). THE LOOP, FROM THE LOGS (Vercel runtime logs, read only): every request was a GET for a visible Link, one per Link per cycle, which is Next's pingVisibleLinks re-scheduling every on-screen Link after a router invalidation. dpl_DRQ9 14:00 to 14:10Z: 15 shell routes about 860 each, /feed 2,193, all 200. A second tab on dpl_CvaywacE4 16:00 to 16:10Z: every visible Link about 40 a minute, with no request for the page. Both fast phases stopped between 16:00 and 16:30Z. After that the second tab showed exactly 2 per Link per 90 s: the heartbeat cadence. CAUSE ONE, PROVEN AND REPRODUCED on a local Next 16.3.6 build: the proxy wrote fq_acct (and fq_ask in prior-consent regions) on every response. Next merges a proxy cookie into a Server Action's cookie store and reports the action as cookies changed, and the client then invalidates its whole prefetch cache and re-prefetches every visible Link. Four heartbeat pings: 53 requests with the cookie, 16 without. CAUSE TWO, NOT IDENTIFIED: the fast cycle's clock. There was no POST and no page request, which fits a route-cache invalidation inside the router (Next's dynamic-rewrite retry, whose source says it cannot loop and carries a TODO to bound it) on the proxy-rewritten /events and /spaces Links, but it was not reproduced under next start. FIX: (1) lib/nav/prefetch-fuse.ts, installed from instrumentation-client.ts, caps router prefetches at 4 per route and 60 per tab per 60 s, and none while the tab is hidden. It answers a blocked prefetch with a local 429, which the router rejects with its own 10 s backoff, and it never touches navigations or Server Actions. It holds for any trigger: the local 1-per-second loop fell from 221 requests to 77 in 30 s. (2) lib/nav/marker-cookie.ts: the proxy writes fq_acct and fq_ask only when missing or on a full page load. (3) components/presence/presence-gate.ts: the heartbeat pings at most once per 60 s from module state, so a remount or a visibility flap cannot re-ping, and a failing ping backs off up to 30 min. NOT DONE: no deploymentId or skew config. The old tab was answered by its own deployment for nine hours, so no new build can reach it, and a mismatch reload would never have fired. Skew Protection max age is an owner platform setting and is recorded in the ADR. TESTS: lib/nav/prefetch-fuse.test.ts, proxy-markers.test.ts (the real proxy) and components/presence/heartbeat.test.tsx. Each fails on the pre-change code. STILL TO READ: the 24-hour runtime-log check after deploy, that no client exceeds one request a second on member routes. That read is the orchestrator's.
